mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate falls below 0.1%, it indicates emergency monetary easing that stimulates short-term economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered periods, or the signal fails to outperform market in 70% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate broad demand contraction, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Negative returns occur in less than 55% of interaction-triggered periods, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 7.5%), labor market weakness reduces consumer spending power, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of high-unemployment periods, or the regime-specific Rank IC is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls signals robust labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of payroll growth periods, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 95% of its 2017 base, it indicates significant supply-side contraction that raises recession risks, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered periods, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In housing market recovery regimes (HOUST > 1400 thousand units), increased housing activity signals stronger consumer confidence and economic growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of housing recovery periods, or the regime-specific Rank IC is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in federal funds rate and rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%) indicates stagflationary policy dilemma, increasing market volatility and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Negative returns occur in less than 55% of interaction-triggered periods, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.02.
